source-integrity.provenance: SEC primary filing plus independent FT and market-data origins
source-integrity.duplicateOriginCollapse: company-release syndication treated as one issuer origin and not independent corroboration
source-integrity.sourceIndependence: SEC, FT and S&P-derived market data are materially distinct origins
source-integrity.rawDerivedConsistency: packet financial and risk claims are consistent with cited SEC lineage; valuation is separately sourced

company-underwriting.financialOperatingTrajectory: Q2 FY2027 revenue $116.1M, +58% YoY; backlog about $814.9M; 98% recurring ACV; adjusted EBITDA positive, while GAAP net loss and capital intensity remain material.
company-underwriting.balanceSheet: Packet lineage reports about $865.4M cash/cash equivalents/short-term investments; ATM usage and rising share count preserve dilution risk.
company-underwriting.customersContracts: Defense/intelligence contract expansion and sovereign demand support visibility; defense concentration also creates procurement/customer risk.
company-underwriting.governanceCapitalAllocation: Founder-led execution and constellation/factory investment are evident; long-duration capital-allocation quality remains less proven than operating momentum.
company-underwriting.pricingPowerConcentration: Recurring ACV and backlog support value capture, but hardware mix, defense concentration and substitute geospatial sources limit a stronger conclusion.
company-underwriting.catalysts: Berlin Pelican manufacturing capacity and sovereign European demand are current catalysts; utilization and award conversion remain uncertain.
risks: substitution by competing or government-owned imagery

thesisQuality.basis: 58% YoY revenue growth, high recurring ACV and large backlog demonstrate adoption and demand durability, offset by GAAP losses and hardware-mix complexity.

financialOperatingMomentum.basis: Strong revenue/backlog growth and adjusted profitability coexist with GAAP loss, capex growth and dilution risk.

marketValuationOpportunity.basis: At roughly $6.21B market cap / $5.84B EV against about $378M TTM revenue, valuation remains demanding despite growth and a large decline from prior highs.

catalystScore.basis: Berlin production capacity and active sovereign/defense demand create identifiable catalysts, but factory utilization and award conversion are not yet proven.

governancePower.basis: Management has executed substantial growth and capacity investment, but ongoing losses, ATM issuance and capital intensity keep stewardship evidence mixed rather than exceptional.

alignment2036.basis: Persistent Earth observation and sovereign geospatial intelligence are durable infrastructure/security needs with expanding European demand.

crossDivisionLeverage.basis: Core satellite/data capability serves government, defense and commercial use cases, though current demand is increasingly defense-concentrated.

bottleneckControl.basis: Owned constellation, ground infrastructure and new manufacturing capacity create meaningful scarce capability and lead-time control, but competing constellations remain substitutes.

scenarioRobustness.basis: Commercial and sovereign use cases provide multiple demand paths, offset by capital intensity and meaningful defense concentration.

substitutionResilience.basis: Persistent high-cadence proprietary imagery and infrastructure create moderate replacement barriers, but alternative commercial and government systems can substitute portions of the offering.

supplyChainResilience.basis: Expanded Berlin manufacturing adds geographic capacity, but satellite production, launch and constellation dependencies remain material and redundancy is not fully demonstrated.

pricingPower.basis: Recurring ACV and backlog support moderate value capture, while contract concentration, hardware mix and competitive substitutes limit evidence for durable scarcity rent.

riskEvidence.basis: Material risks remain from GAAP losses, capex, dilution, defense concentration, substitution and demanding valuation; strong liquidity and backlog partially offset them.

dataConfidenceEvidence.basis: Primary SEC financial evidence is current and independently supplemented for capacity/demand and valuation; customer economics, Berlin utilization and long-run pricing remain incompletely disclosed.

scoreRecord.thesis: Planet combines a scaled proprietary Earth-observation constellation with accelerating sovereign/defense demand and expanding manufacturing capacity; the opportunity is structurally relevant but valuation, capital intensity and concentration constrain present asymmetry.
scoreRecord.keyRisk: Execution must convert backlog and capacity into durable GAAP economics without excessive dilution while defending against alternative imagery sources.
scoreRecord.nextCatalyst: Conversion of European sovereign/defense pipeline and Berlin Pelican capacity into contracted revenue and improved GAAP/cash economics.

contradictions.item: High recurring ACV/backlog coexists with point-in-time hardware contribution to growth.

unknowns.item: Berlin utilization/unit economics and exact sovereign award conversion remain undisclosed.
Long-run customer concentration and renewal economics remain uncertain.
